violation_type.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Show Appreciation of Children's Efforts and Accomplishments (26 TAC §746.1203(9))
violation_type.short_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Show Appreciation of Children's Efforts and Accomplishments
violation_type.typical_finding: During this investigation, it was determined a caregiver did not show appreciation of children's efforts when the children approached the caregiver after completing assignments.
